statement.zh: 中国社会科学院考古研究所1980年正式出版《殷墟妇好墓》，报告安阳殷墟妇好墓（M5）发掘与随葬组合。
statement.en: CASS published the 1980 primary report Tomb of Lady Hao at Yinxu for Anyang tomb M5 and its burial assemblage.
